applied_to_claim: Whether the known affine half-band positive-current obstruction blocks interface C after a legitimate restriction-maximal critical-core reduction, and which authentic fleet02 parent masks survive that reduction.
result: Every affine-subspace defect has H<4J. If its quotient has m>c nonzero physical columns, a redundant physical coordinate restriction preserves codimension and entropy, reduces J by exactly 2^(1-c), and raises H/J by m/(m-1). The half-band witness has m=c+1 and is therefore not restriction-maximal. The authentic coordinate-subcube parents have m=c and survive; scalar positive plaquette inversion still carries the codimension normalization loss.
refutation_attempt: The stronger statement that every affine-subspace defect has a strict ratio-improving restriction is false in the irredundant m=c branch: coordinate-subcube defects have no redundant nonzero quotient column. This sharpens the theorem to the exact m>c hypothesis.
remaining_implication: Prove a source-exact compensated live-window contraction for restriction-maximal/high-ratio cores at the precompression three-phase field level, or produce a restriction-maximal Boolean counterexample. Do not return to scalar positive parent reconstruction.
mechanism_change: universal positive-current payment -> restriction-critical affine geometry plus precompression signed transport
